e.title: insurance-eqrn (Burning Cost)
e.summary: 极值分位数回归神经网络（EQRN）保险定价库：极端损失分位数的深度学习方法
e.body:
insurance-eqrn 是 Burning Cost 栈的极值分位数回归神经网络（Extreme Quantile Regression Neural Network）库：用神经网络做保险定价的极端分位数（EQRN）——重尾损失的极值分位数预测（大额损失定价、尾部风险附加）。对 RIAA：极值理论×深度学习的定价方法实现。与 [[insurance-quantile]]（分位数回归）、[[insurance-severity]]（严重度）、[[mev]]/[[extremes]]（EVT）互补。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[reinsurance]]、[[vares]]。

## 同类工具
[[insurance-multivariate-conformal]]、[[insurance-nflow]]、[[insurance-reconcile]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]

e.summary_en: Extreme Quantile Regression Neural Network (EQRN) library for insurance pricing: deep learning of extreme-loss quantiles
e.summary_hk: 極值分位數回歸神經網絡（EQRN）保險定價庫：極端損失分位數的深度學習方法
e.body_en:
insurance-eqrn is the Burning Cost stack's Extreme Quantile Regression Neural Network (EQRN) library: neural networks for extreme quantiles in insurance pricing — extreme-quantile prediction of heavy-tailed losses (large-loss pricing, tail-risk loadings). For RIAA: the deep-learning × extreme-value implementation for pricing. Complements [[insurance-quantile]] (quantile regression), [[insurance-severity]] (severity) and [[mev]]/[[extremes]] (EVT). Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[reinsurance]], [[vares]].

## Similar tools
[[insurance-multivariate-conformal]]、[[insurance-nflow]]、[[insurance-reconcile]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]

insurance-eqrn 是 Burning Cost 棧的極值分位數回歸神經網絡（Extreme Quantile Regression Neural Network）庫：用神經網絡做保險定價的極端分位數（EQRN）——重尾損失的極值分位數預測（大額損失定價、尾部風險附加）。對 RIAA：極值理論×深度學習的定價方法實現。與 [[insurance-quantile]]（分位數回歸）、[[insurance-severity]]（嚴重度）、[[mev]]/[[extremes]]（EVT）互補。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[reinsurance]]、[[vares]]。
